leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: Teachers shall follow the procedures set forth for the automated substitute calling system. ... Before a personal leave of absence, teachers shall make every reasonable effort to notify the substitute coordinator prior to seven o'clock p.m. the night before the absence ... Whenever practicable the teacher will ensure that lesson plans for student activities are available for the substitute ... Items such as class rolls, seating charts, and registers of attendance should be available where applicable.
